content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — MINCOMMIT (§ 2.1, p0012).** The clause imposes a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment on us with no reduction or termination right — the playbook walk-away scenario — and it directly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment (and § 7.1's bar on undisclosed minimum-use charges).

Redline (validated, preferred level): § 2.1 replaced so that we have no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment and pay only for Services actually ordered or used. The comment flags the § 12.3 inconsistency and offers the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty) if a commitment is commercially essential.
